issues.description: The problem statement requires counting swimming pools in Gemeinden with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution’s WHERE clause uses 'Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000'. This mismatch between the described threshold (1000) and the implemented threshold (2000) will cause correct student queries (using >1000) to disagree with the provided solution and test results, creating confusion and incorrect automatic grading.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the threshold consistent. Either change the solution query to use 'AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000' so it matches the problem statement, or update the problem text to require 'mehr als 2000 weiblichen Einwohnerinnen' if 2000 was intended. Prefer changing the solution to >1000 to align with the problem description.
